BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_MAX_RECORDS.prompt: Row ceiling for a query when --max-records is not given

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_MAX_TOKENS.prompt: Output allowance per call (the floor a cost ceiling has to clear)

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_TIMEOUT.prompt: Seconds to wait for one provider call

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_MAX_PARALLEL.prompt: Provider calls in flight at once (1 = sequential)

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_CACHE.prompt: Answer a repeated call from the on-disk cache

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_CACHE_DIR.prompt: Where cached answers are kept. Default: the cache directory in the CLI home

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_PRICE_PER_INPUT_TOK.prompt: Your input rate per token, for a model the price table does not carry

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_PRICE_PER_OUTPUT_TO.prompt: Your output rate per token, for a model the price table does not carry

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_VARIANT.prompt: Source variant within the llm protocol

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_LIMIT_COST.prompt: Default spend ceiling for one request, in USD

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_LIMIT_SECONDS.prompt: Default age ceiling for one request, in seconds

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_LIMIT_CALLS.prompt: Default call ceiling for one request

BLUE_DATA_LLM_SOURCE_EFFORT.prompt: Continuation allowance: low, medium, or high
